title: Hinomori Shizuku — MORE MORE JUMP!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That was a good session.
Next week, we can dance the entire song.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And from there, we'll keep perfecting our choreography.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They're talking about it as if everything was fine, but I still can't do this dance well.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I made so many mistakes in my steps, and I couldn't follow what everyone else was doing...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hey, Minori. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? No, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh well... I'll have to practice the parts I'm no good with at home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I got a message?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Who's it from? Oh...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sorry for calling you out to practice with me some more...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's no problem at all.
I also wanted to work on that dance a bit more.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are Airi and Haruka not coming?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't ask them to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They've got this dance down to a T, so I didn't want to bother them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Er... I-I wasn't trying to say your dancing wasn't so good, nothing like that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, it's okay. I know that I didn't do so well today. Let's work on improving together, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes. Thanks, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Maybe I shouldn't have kept this secret from Haruka and Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. It's understandable.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You didn't want to disappoint Haruka, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... Were you thinking the same?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Almost. I want to make Airi proud.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So let's make this our top secret special drill.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Top secret special drill? That's got a cool ring to it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Are you ready to begin?
Let's surprise Haruka and Airi tomorrow by dancing perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Five, six, seven, eight!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
It always goes downhill towards the end.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think it's because you don't shift weight the right way and it adds up over time until you fall out of step.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aah, is that what's going on? I'll be more careful!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori, did you notice what I'm doing wrong? It seems to me that my transition between moves isn't as crisp as it should be...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... You perform every part of the choreography with a lot of care...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that could be why your movements don't seem crisp!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka told me that you need to vary the tempo to make each part more distinctive!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That could be it.
I'll pay more attention to changes in the tempo.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Good luck! Let's try again from the start!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huff... Oof...
I think we're getting there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's all coming together—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Told you they'd be here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi and Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We sensed there was something odd about you two after practice, so we came here on a hunch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You looked like you were beating yourselves up over not quite getting the dance steps.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So you two are having a private practice session, is that it? Haruka, what should we do with them?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's have them show us the dance moves they practiced without us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's see if you've made any progress!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm happy to do so!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's getting dark, so you only have one try.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's going to be enough! Let's do this, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm ready!
